skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts of Blockchain technology including decentralized principles, transparency, security, and immutability.
Understand the architecture of a block in Blockchain, consensus algorithms such as Proof of Work (PoW) and Proof of Stake (PoS).
Proficiently use popular Blockchain development platforms like Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, and Corda.
Proficiently use programming languages, libraries, and tools for developing Blockchain with smart contracts.
Understand and apply security measures for Blockchain applications.
Develop skills in designing Blockchain with consensus algorithms.
Develop skills in creating Blockchain applications on platforms like Ethereum, Hyperledger Fabric, and Corda.
Develop skills in using programming languages, libraries, and tools for Blockchain development with smart contracts.
Develop skills in securing Blockchain applications.
Develop the ability to independently learn and understand materials to complete assigned tasks.
Develop awareness of classroom discipline, adherence to class rules, and a sense of cooperation and personal responsibility for activities assigned by instructors.
